reason: The README describes a web settings plugin for adding, editing, enabling, reconnecting, and deleting MCP servers, with live status, OAuth support, configuration hot sync, and runtime tool registration; human review is warranted because it can execute arbitrary stdio commands and manage external authenticated connections.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页设置中运行时管理 MCP 服务器，包括添加、编辑、启停、重连、删除、状态查看和 OAuth 配置。
summaries.en: Manage MCP servers at runtime from DeepSeek Harness web settings, including adding, editing, enabling, reconnecting, deleting, monitoring, and configuring OAuth.

capabilities: Manages MCP server configurations at runtime
Starts and disconnects stdio or HTTP MCP servers
Executes arbitrary commands for configured stdio servers
Connects to external MCP endpoints and supports OAuth token handling
Exposes local HTTP management endpoints and registers MCP tools globally
